title: Zombie
hook: Why Zombie *hurts* with pop's happiest chords

chords.name: Em
chords.text: It starts on *E minor*. Already wounded…

chords.name: G
chords.text: …then *G*, the chord that should feel like home…

chords.name: D
chords.text: …then *D*. The same loop as countless happy hits.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: But it *keeps falling back* to E minor. That's the ache.

question: Name another sad song built on happy chords 👇
